scope: Research catalogue for future rule promotion. This file is not a production rulebook and contains no universal geometry values.
authority_order: selected product safety and regulatory standard
selected fabricator and assembler capability profile
exact component datasheet errata and manufacturer design guide
exact manufacturer reference design with matching topology and package

rule_classes.hard: Fail-closed requirement derived from declared project context and an applicable authority.
rule_classes.derived: Numerical constraint computed from declared inputs such as stack-up, timing budget, load step, or environment.
rule_classes.advisory: Evidence-backed review prompt that needs engineering judgement or measurement.
rule_classes.simulation: Constraint requiring an identified solver, model, measurement, or laboratory acceptance method.

families.name: Architecture, exact MPN identity, and support circuits
hard_checks: all power, ground, exposed-pad, reset, boot, programming, and reference pins resolved
pin and package identity verified against manufacturer data
support roles traced to evidence
advisory_checks: reference design divergence recorded with consequence
errata and lifecycle review
alternate parts do not silently inherit the original pin or layout rules

families.name: Power tree, current budget, sequencing, ramp, and reset
required_context: static and transient current by mode
hard_checks: regulator capacity includes declared transients and margin
sequencing and reset dependencies are explicit
no rail is back-powered through I/O or protection structures
advisory_checks: power domains can be measured independently during bring-up
enable defaults are deterministic
fault states and discharge paths are documented

families.name: Power entry, reverse polarity, inrush, surge, fuse, and hot-swap
hard_checks: protection chain order is explicit
MOSFET and resistor pulse energy are checked
inrush and connector ratings are checked
reverse and fault current paths are bounded
advisory_checks: TVS clamping and downstream absolute maximum use the same current assumption
fuse clearing and wiring capability are coordinated

families.name: Power-distribution network and decoupling
hard_checks: every required supply pin has an evidence-backed local network
decoupling current loop is topologically minimized
plane necks and via current paths are checked
advisory_checks: target impedance is derived as delta-V over delta-I for a declared time or frequency range
anti-resonance and package inductance are reviewed
capacitor value is not accepted without voltage-bias derating

families.name: Stack-up, materials, controlled impedance, and reference structure
hard_checks: routing dimensions are generated from the selected stack-up
critical signals have a continuous declared reference
layer transitions include an appropriate return-current transition
advisory_checks: reference-guide widths are not copied to a different stack-up
glass weave and loss tangent are evaluated where data rate requires it
validation: fabricator field solver or approved impedance model

families.name: Return-current continuity, partitioning, and EMC zoning
hard_checks: no critical signal crosses an unintended plane void or split
return transitions are colocated with signal transitions
no arbitrary ground split is used as a substitute for current-path design
advisory_checks: zoning is based on current paths and susceptibility rather than component labels
common-mode conversion risks are reviewed

families.name: Clocks, crystals, oscillators, PLLs, and jitter
hard_checks: load network is calculated for the exact parts
clock pins and unused references follow manufacturer rules
reference clock has a continuous quiet return path
advisory_checks: negative-resistance or transconductance margin is verified
probe loading and test method are planned
clock supply isolation is justified by the exact IC
validation: phase-noise or jitter analysis where required

families.name: High-speed single-ended and differential digital routing
triggers: fast edge relative to flight time
hard_checks: net classes are interface-specific
reference continuity and transition symmetry are enforced
AC coupling location and orientation follow the exact interface
stubs and test points obey the channel budget
advisory_checks: pair coupling is not maximized blindly
fiber weave mitigation is considered
package delays are included before board-level length matching
validation: post-layout insertion and return loss review

families.name: DDR, LPDDR, and source-synchronous memory
hard_checks: vendor-defined byte lanes and timing groups are preserved
topology-specific termination and placement are explicit
all length constraints are derived from timing rather than copied globally
advisory_checks: address mirroring and clamshell tradeoffs are documented
via and layer asymmetry are included
power and reference-noise budgets are reviewed

families.name: Ethernet PHY, magnetics, chassis, and MDI routing
hard_checks: PHY-to-magnetics placement and MDI routing follow the exact guide
chassis and circuit-ground strategy is declared
center taps and terminations are resolved
advisory_checks: magnetics metal keepout and pair-to-pair coupling are reviewed
return vias and shield current paths are visible in review images

families.name: RF paths, antennas, matching, shielding, and enclosure effects
required_context: enclosure battery cable and metal geometry
hard_checks: antenna all-layer keepout and board-edge placement are declared
feed impedance is stack-up-derived
matching network and tuning access are provided
RF ground and stitching follow the exact reference design
advisory_checks: reference-layout divergence is recorded
final tuning is performed in the assembled enclosure
shield and coexistence needs are reviewed

families.name: Switching regulators, gate drive, hot loops, and switch nodes
hard_checks: critical hot loops are explicitly modeled and minimized
switch-node copper is bounded
feedback and Kelvin sense avoid power-current voltage drop
gate-drive source and return form a controlled loop
advisory_checks: EMI versus thermal copper tradeoff is recorded
snubber and damping footprints are considered
light-load and fault modes are reviewed

families.name: Motor drivers, high-current switching, current sense, and regenerative energy
hard_checks: power and gate-current loops are identified
shunt Kelvin nodes are protected from load copper
regenerative and fault energy have a destination
copper and via current paths are calculated
advisory_checks: layout symmetry and phase balance are reviewed
dead-time and shoot-through risks are recorded
measurement amplifier common-mode transients are checked

families.name: Precision analog, converters, high-impedance nodes, and mixed signal
hard_checks: signal and return current paths are controlled
reference and analog supply support circuits match the exact IC
high-impedance nodes have declared leakage and contamination controls
advisory_checks: guarding and shielding are considered
thermal EMF and matched-component gradients are reviewed
digital partitioning does not create ground slots
validation: bench calibration and noise test plan

families.name: Sensors, airflow, contamination, self-heating, and mechanical coupling
hard_checks: sensor package and apertures follow manufacturer constraints
known heat sources and copper thermal bridges are declared
environmental access is not blocked by coating or enclosure
advisory_checks: self-heating and duty cycle are evaluated
removal slots or isolation are evidence-backed
calibration and field placement are considered

families.name: Thermal paths, current density, copper, vias, and component derating
hard_checks: temperature rise and voltage drop are both evaluated
via arrays use real geometry and process assumptions
component and interconnect current ratings include duty and transient behavior
advisory_checks: theta-JA is not treated as a universal board property
thermal vias do not silently violate paste or assembly constraints
copper balance and warpage are reviewed

families.name: ESD, EFT, surge, conducted and radiated EMC
hard_checks: connector to protection to protected IC ordering is enforced
unprotected trace length and coupling are bounded
protection return path is short and low inductance
shield current does not traverse logic ground unintentionally
advisory_checks: filter and TVS parasitics are compatible with the interface
spark gaps and chassis coupling need explicit process authority

families.name: Galvanic isolation, creepage, clearance, insulation, and safety
hard_checks: creepage and clearance are derived from the selected safety context
barrier geometry is checked on every conductive layer
slots and coating receive credit only when the applicable standard and process allow it
advisory_checks: EMI return path across the barrier does not undermine isolation
test access and fixture clearances preserve the barrier

families.name: BGA, HDI, microvias, via-in-pad, escape, and assembly
required_context: exact package drawing and ball map
hard_checks: escape feasibility is proven before part and layer-count lock
via-in-pad uses a declared fill and cap process
solder mask and paste strategy match package and assembly evidence
inspection access is planned
advisory_checks: microvia stacking and high-stress structures receive reliability review
BGA breakout is coordinated with PDN and return vias
X-ray and rework limitations are recorded
validation: cross-section or coupon plan where justified

families.name: Fabrication, solder mask, paste, assembly, panelization, and finish
hard_checks: DRC limits come from the selected process profile
mask and paste apertures are process-aware
panel rails tooling fiducials and breakaway geometry are resolved
component overhang and handling constraints are checked
advisory_checks: copper balance and thieving are coordinated with the fabricator
finish choice is justified for pitch storage life and contact use

families.name: Test access, debug, programming, boundary scan, and bring-up
hard_checks: programming and recovery path remains accessible
required rails and resets have safe measurement access
test points are prohibited where their stubs violate a critical channel
advisory_checks: boundary scan and built-in self-test are considered
boot straps can be verified without destructive probing
current-limited first-power procedure is documented

families.name: Reliability, lifecycle, derating, contamination, vibration, and service
hard_checks: component voltage current power and temperature derating are declared
mechanical retention and strain-sensitive packages are reviewed
lifecycle state and replacement strategy are recorded
advisory_checks: MLCC flex cracking and DC-bias loss are considered
CAF dendrite and contamination risks are considered
field-update and recovery strategy are documented

families.name: Symbols, footprints, 3D models, mechanical fit, and asset provenance
hard_checks: symbol pins are reconciled with the datasheet
footprint geometry is measured against the package drawing
3D model is aligned 1:1 in millimeters
model fidelity is labelled exact package complete module connector-only or proxy
advisory_checks: manufacturer CAD is preferred over aggregators
every imported asset is visually inspected
model presence is not treated as footprint correctness

complexity_escalation.description: Moderate mixed-signal, switching, RF module, motor, or external-interface board
Controlled-impedance, dense BGA, DDR, isolation, or multi-rail SoC board
Multi-gigabit SerDes, FPGA, RFSoC, safety-critical, HDI, or certification-bound board
required_gates: channel and PDN simulation with controlled models
formal design review with unresolved-risk register
